name: The Nation cryptic crossword No 3489
preamble: Puzzled? No more cross words! Read Kosman and Picciotto on “Solving The Nation’s Cryptic Puzzles.” Or watch this video.

clue.text: Fashion celebrity's bad mood cut short when taking in poetic tribute to a hairstyle?

indicators.note: something cut short loses its end, so the last letter of the word for a bad mood is dropped
to take in is to admit inside oneself, so the shortened word wraps around the other piece

blocks.note: a sulk is a fit of bad temper
an ode is a poem of praise and a perm is a curled hairstyle: a 'perm ode'

explanation.surface: A famous fashion figure in a foul temper is soothed by a poem praising a hairdo.
explanation.walkthrough: The bad-mood word loses only its last letter, and the poem-for-a-hairdo goes in after its second letter, not in the exact middle.
explanation.definitionFit: A supermodel is a model famous enough to be a celebrity of the fashion world.

clue.text: Volunteers sing off-key and have dinner

indicators.note: singing off-key puts the notes out of order, so the letters of the word are jumbled

blocks.note: taken as written
to sup is to eat supper

explanation.surface: Volunteer choristers sing badly, then go for a meal.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Volunteers' looks like a noun; it is the verb, matched by the phrasal verb in the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: To sign up is to enlist or put one's name down for something, that is, to volunteer.

clue.text: Boy extended play, mounting piece of tricycle

indicators.note: in a down entry mounting means climbing upwards, so the letters read from the bottom up

blocks.note: a lad is a boy
an EP is an extended-play record

explanation.surface: A boy, at length at play, climbs onto part of his tricycle.
explanation.definitionFit: A tricycle is driven by pedals on its front wheel, so a pedal is one of its parts.

clue.text: Gather around to insist on small taunt from a victorious gambler

indicators.note: in a down entry one thing on another sits directly above it, so the pieces follow in that order
around means encircling, so the first word wraps about the rest

blocks.note: to reap is to gather a harvest
to demand is to insist
wee means small

explanation.surface: Crowd round and insist on a little gloating from someone who has won a bet.
explanation.walkthrough: The enumeration splits the letters differently from the wordplay, so the pieces straddle the word breaks of the poker phrase.
explanation.definitionFit: 'Read 'em and weep' is the triumphant line a poker player says while laying down a winning hand.

clue.text: Burn bad cover disk, all right?

indicators.note: something gone bad is spoilt and out of shape, so the next word's letters are rearranged

blocks.note: taken as written
O is shaped like a disk
OK means all right

explanation.surface: Is it all right to burn a bad cover version onto a disc?
explanation.walkthrough: The surface is about copying music to CD; 'Burn' is the cooking sense, and 'disk' is just the round letter O.
explanation.definitionFit: To overcook food is to cook it too long, so that it ends up burnt.

clue.text: Bury Monet in ruins west of Brittany

indicators.note: something in ruins is wrecked and scattered, so the name's letters are rearranged
the west of a word is its left-hand end, so only its opening letter is used

blocks.note: taken as written
the first letter of Brittany

explanation.surface: Laying the painter Monet to rest among ruins in western France.
explanation.walkthrough: 'West of Brittany' reads as a place, the far west of France; here it means the westernmost letter of the word.
explanation.definitionFit: To entomb is to place a body in a tomb, that is, to bury it.

clue.text: Doctor said, "This is a good place to speak"

definitions.text: This is a good place to speak

indicators.note: to doctor is to tamper with or alter, so the next word's letters are rearranged

blocks.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: A physician offers a remark about where a speech is best delivered.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Doctor said' reads as a physician talking, with the quotation as his words; in fact 'Doctor' is a verb acting on 'said', and the quotation is the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: A dais is a raised platform from which a speaker addresses an audience.

clue.text: Mad albino is sick in the stomach

indicators.note: being sick suggests being upset and churned up, so the letters before it are rearranged

blocks.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: A deranged albino has a stomach upset.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Mad' looks like the anagram signal, but it is fodder: the nine letters of 'Mad albino' are needed, and 'is sick' does the mixing.
explanation.definitionFit: Abdominal describes what is located in the belly, the region containing the stomach.

clue.text: Checker's helper: second person who makes preserves

blocks.note: s is the abbreviation for second
a canner preserves food in cans or jars

explanation.surface: A checkers player's assistant doubles as someone who makes jam.
explanation.walkthrough: The checker is a supermarket checkout clerk, not a board-game player; the second is a time unit, not a duelling assistant.
explanation.definitionFit: A checkout clerk uses a barcode scanner to ring up items, so it is a tool that assists the checker.

clue.text: Republicans aren't accommodating Democratic sponsor

indicators.note: accommodating means giving room to, so the letters around make space for one more inside

blocks.note: the Grand Old Party, the usual nickname of the US Republican Party
taken as written, apostrophe dropped
D is the standard abbreviation for Democratic

explanation.surface: A political jab: the Republicans refuse to make room for a Democrat's backer.
explanation.walkthrough: GOP, the Grand Old Party, is an American nickname for the Republicans; the inserted letter lands just after its first two letters.
explanation.definitionFit: At a baptism a godparent stands as sponsor for the child, vouching for its religious upbringing.

clue.text: Sorceress's concept: I became an object

indicators.note: became means turned into something else, so one part of the word is exchanged for another

blocks.note: an idea is a concept
the pronoun, as a letter in that word
me is the object form of the pronoun I, a grammar joke

explanation.surface: A witch muses philosophically that she has been turned into a mere thing.
explanation.walkthrough: In IDEA the I, the subject pronoun, becomes the object pronoun ME: ME-DEA. 'Object' here is grammatical, not a thing.
explanation.definitionFit: Medea is the sorceress of Greek myth who helped Jason win the Golden Fleece.

clue.text: Frequently interrupting refusals in Moscow and London, weight is hoisted for ballerina

indicators.note: to interrupt is to break in on, so this piece is placed in the middle of another
in a down entry hoisting lifts everything upward, so the whole string reads from the bottom up

blocks.note: nyet is Russian for no
the English refusal
oft is a poetic word for often
a gram is a unit of weight

explanation.surface: Constant noes in Russia and Britain as a weight is lifted for a dancer.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Hoisted' applies to the whole string built so far, not just the weight, so everything is read upward together.
explanation.definitionFit: Dame Margot Fonteyn was the celebrated English prima ballerina of the Royal Ballet.

clue.text: Soothe, except when absorbing loss

indicators.note: absorbing means soaking up and holding within, so one piece sits inside the other

blocks.note: save means except, as in 'all save one'
L is the abbreviation for loss, as in a win-loss record

explanation.surface: Advice on comfort: calm someone, except when they are taking a hit.
explanation.definitionFit: To salve is to ease or calm, as an ointment does a wound or kind words do hurt feelings.

clue.text: Some members of the film crew arrived with noodles

definitions.text: Some members of the film crew

blocks.note: came is the past tense of come, to arrive
ramen are Japanese wheat noodles

explanation.surface: Part of a film crew turned up on set carrying noodles for lunch.
explanation.definitionFit: Camera operators are members of a film crew, those who work the cameras.

clue.text: Bother to break up President Taft's original design element

indicators.note: original means the very first, so only the opening letter of the name is kept
to break something up is to split it apart, so another piece is pushed into the gap

blocks.note: James K. Polk was the eleventh US president
the first letter of the name Taft
ado is fuss or bother

explanation.surface: Someone sets out to disrupt the original design work of President Taft.
explanation.walkthrough: The surface pairs 'President Taft', but they are two pieces: the president is a different one, and Taft supplies only its initial.
explanation.definitionFit: Polka dots are a pattern of evenly spaced round spots used in fabric and graphic design.

clue.text: Lo-cal demonstration (that's not a figure of speech)

definitions.text: that's not a figure of speech

blocks.note: lite is the marketing spelling for low-calorie products
a rally is a protest demonstration

explanation.surface: A protest for diet food, and the speaker insists this is no metaphor.
explanation.definitionFit: Literally is used to stress that words are meant in their exact sense, not metaphorically.

clue.text: Trap disheartened medical examiner

indicators.note: losing heart means losing the middle, so the central letter of the word is removed

blocks.note: a coroner investigates deaths, the role of a medical examiner

explanation.surface: A dispirited medical examiner is caught in some kind of snare.
explanation.walkthrough: CORONER has seven letters, so its heart is the fourth: the middle O goes.
explanation.definitionFit: To corner someone is to trap them where they cannot escape, as into the corner of a room.

clue.text: Mark, tossing out a fruit-and-pork loaf

indicators.note: tossing out means throwing away, so the following little word is removed from the first piece

blocks.note: a scar is a mark left by a wound
an apple is a fruit

explanation.surface: Mark rejects a meatloaf made with fruit and pork.
explanation.walkthrough: SCAR loses its A, the 'a' of the clue, to leave SCR. 'Fruit-and-pork loaf' looks like one dish; 'fruit' is wordplay and only 'pork loaf' defines.
explanation.definitionFit: Scrapple is a Pennsylvania Dutch dish of pork scraps and cornmeal set in a loaf, then sliced and fried.

clue.text: Happen to act as a detergent

blocks.note: to be something is to act as it, as when an actor is a king
Tide is a well-known American brand of laundry detergent

explanation.surface: An odd instruction: occur so as to work as a cleaning product.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Be Tide' means play the part of the detergent brand, joined as BETIDE.
explanation.definitionFit: Betide is an old-fashioned verb meaning to happen or befall, as in 'woe betide you'.

clue.text: Primates benefit in degrees

indicators.note: in means placed within, so one piece is put inside the other

blocks.note: BAs are Bachelor of Arts degrees
a boon is a benefit or blessing

explanation.surface: Apes profit from having college degrees.
explanation.definitionFit: Baboons are large African monkeys, members of the primate order.

clue.text: Criminal company in San Francisco is at fault

indicators.note: in means placed within, so one abbreviation goes inside the other

blocks.note: SF is the usual abbreviation for San Francisco
Co. is the abbreviation for company
a flaw is a fault or defect

explanation.surface: A crooked firm based in San Francisco is to blame.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Is at' only joins the pieces; 'fault' alone supplies the last part.
explanation.definitionFit: A scofflaw is someone who habitually flouts the law, a minor lawbreaker.

clue.text: Like a wild animal overturning base angle

indicators.note: overturning turns something upside down, which in a down entry means reading the word from the bottom up

blocks.note: low means base, mean or contemptible
to angle is to fish

explanation.surface: A wild beast knocks over a base at an angle.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Angle' looks geometric but is the verb meaning to go fishing.
explanation.definitionFit: Wolfish means resembling a wolf, which is a wild animal, especially in being fierce or ravenous.

clue.text: Controversy setting back Arabic translation: Winnie ____?

indicators.note: setting something back turns it the other way, so the letters are read in the opposite direction

blocks.note: al is the Arabic word for the, so the bear's title becomes Winnie al-Pooh

explanation.surface: A row over an Arabic version of the famous bear's name: Winnie what?
explanation.walkthrough: The blank is 'the Pooh', which an Arabic translation would render with the article al.
explanation.definitionFit: Hoopla means excitement, fuss or a public commotion, such as a controversy stirs up.

clue.text: Forbid part of cartoon pertaining to a European city

blocks.note: to bar is to forbid
a cel is one transparent sheet of a hand-drawn animated cartoon
on means about, pertaining to, as in 'a book on birds'
taken as written

explanation.surface: A ban on some animated section relating to a city on the Continent.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Pertaining to a European city' looks like the definition of an adjective; the definition is only 'European city', and 'pertaining to a' gives ON A.
explanation.definitionFit: Barcelona is the Catalan capital, Spain's second city.

clue.text: British man in African nation switching sides

indicators.note: switching sides means swapping right for left, so one of those letters is replaced by the other

blocks.note: Niger is a country in West Africa

explanation.surface: A Briton in an African country who changes allegiance.
explanation.walkthrough: In NIGER the R (right) switches to L (left).
explanation.definitionFit: Nigel is a first name thought of as typically English, so it stands for a British man.

clue.text: Clean rear of sleeping area

indicators.note: the rear of a word is its tail end, so only its last letter is used

blocks.note: the last letter of sleeping
room means space or area, as in room to move

explanation.surface: Tidy up the back of the bedroom.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Sleeping area' reads as one phrase for a bedroom, but it splits: the end of 'sleeping', then 'area'.
explanation.definitionFit: To groom is to clean and tidy, as an animal does its fur or a stable hand a horse.

clue.text: 41 nests in half-open flower

indicators.note: half of a four-letter word is two letters, so only the front pair of the word is used
something that nests in settles inside, so one piece goes within the other

blocks.note: the front half of the word open
41 in Roman numerals

explanation.surface: Forty-one birds make their homes in a flower whose petals are partly unfolded.
explanation.walkthrough: '41' looks like a cross-reference to another clue, but this grid has none; it is the Roman numeral XLI.
explanation.definitionFit: The oxlip is a wild flower of the primrose family, a relative of the cowslip.

clue.text: More energetic running, but I shifted to the end to get some meat

indicators.note: a letter shifted to the end is taken out of its place and put back last, after the next piece

blocks.note: peppier means livelier, having more pep
on means running, as a machine that is on
the letter taken out and put back at the end

explanation.surface: Someone livelier from jogging, after a shake-up, gets hold of some meat.
explanation.walkthrough: The letter I is lifted out of the comparative and moved past the 'running' piece to become the final letter.
explanation.definitionFit: Pepperoni is a spicy cured sausage, a kind of meat familiar as a pizza topping.

clue.text: Island in Southeast, outside Kentucky

indicators.note: outside means surrounding, so the first abbreviation wraps around the second

blocks.note: SE is the compass abbreviation
KY is the postal abbreviation for Kentucky

explanation.surface: An island in the Southeast region, just beyond the Kentucky border.
explanation.walkthrough: The surface places an island in the US Southeast; the answer is in Scotland.
explanation.definitionFit: Skye is the largest island of the Inner Hebrides off the west coast of Scotland.

clue.text: Aquatic creature (seabird) moves into path with a certain amount of speed

indicators.note: moving into a place means going to live inside it, so one piece is set inside another

blocks.note: a way is a path
a tern is a seabird
miles per hour, a unit for measuring speed

explanation.surface: A sea creature, a bird in fact, travels quickly along a route.
explanation.walkthrough: The bird is not rearranged: it moves into the path whole, just before its last letter.
explanation.definitionFit: A water nymph is a spirit of myth living in rivers, springs or the sea, like a naiad.
